# LAMMPS Input Script for Magnesium NVT Equilibration

units metal
atom_style atomic

# Read data file
read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/subtasks/magnesium_structure_retrieval_subtask_melting_trial_0/magnesium_structure.data

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/subtasks/magnesium_potential_file_subtask_melting_trial_0/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Replicate the unit cell
replicate 5 5 5

# Define settings
timestep 0.001  # 1 femtosecond

# NVT ensemble
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe etotal press vol density
fix 1 all nvt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1

# Run the simulation
run 10000

# Write the final structure
write_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/subtasks/magnesium_nvt_subtask_melting_trial_0/equilibrated_structure.data

# LAMMPS Input Script for Magnesium NVT Equilibration

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read data file
read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/subtasks/magnesium_structure_retrieval_subtask_melting_trial_3/magnesium_structure.data

# Replicate the unit cell
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/subtasks/magnesium_potential_file_subtask_melting_trial_3/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Set up the simulation
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 5

timestep 0.001

# Define settings for NVT ensemble
fix 1 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1

# Run the simulation
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe ke etotal press vol
run 10000

# Write the final structure
write_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/subtasks/magnesium_nvt_subtask_melting_trial_3/equilibrated_structure.data

# NPT ensemble

# Run the simulation
run 20000

# Unfix the ensemble
unfix 1

# LAMMPS Input Script for Copper NPT Melting Simulation

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read data
read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/subtasks/copper_npt_subtask_melting_trial_2/equilibrated_structure_npt.data

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/subtasks/copper_potential_file_subtask_melting_trial_2/Cu_Zhou04.eam.alloy Cu

# Define settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 5 every 1

# Define thermodynamic output
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe etotal press vol

# Define timestep
timestep 0.001

# Equilibrate system at 300K
fix 1 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0 drag 1.0
run 10000
unfix 1

# NPT heating to induce melting
fix 2 all npt temp 300 2000 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0 drag 1.0
run 20000
unfix 2

# Output final structure
write_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/subtasks/copper_melting_npt_subtask_melting_trial_2/final_structure.data

# Density Calculation Script

# Constants
amu_to_g = 1.66053906660e-24  # amu to grams
ang_to_cm = 1e-24  # Angstrom^3 to cm^3

# Aluminum properties
mass_per_atom_amu = 26.981539
num_atoms = 500

# Box dimensions after replication
box_length_ang = 20.19465

# Calculate total mass in grams
mass_total_g = num_atoms * mass_per_atom_amu * amu_to_g

# Calculate volume in cm^3
volume_cm3 = (box_length_ang ** 3) * ang_to_cm
